mission.goal: earn qualified design-partner review by making one unsupported sentence visibly disappear and turning expert disagreement into a better claim rule
mission.rejected_default: feature launch, omnichannel copy duplication, engagement theater and an AI employee that always says yes
mission.organic_growth_mechanic: public self-indictment + local five-field trial + platform-native challenge + permissioned counterexample loop + stop/repair/continue receipt
mission.edge_play: Create disproportionate attention through a commercially costly act competitors are unlikely to imitate: remove the most memorable unsupported promise before asking for attention.
mission.non_negotiable: No model score, engagement count, scheduler or memory system may publish, contact, spend, broaden a claim or assert an outcome.

team_cells.owns: company-stage diagnosis, one strategic choice, channel concentration and stop/repair/continue decision
team_cells.quality_gate: one costly choice, one rejected default, one falsifier and one named decision owner
team_cells.failure_signature: channel breadth substitutes for a decision
team_cells.scorecard: decision specificity; rejected-option quality; falsifier precision

team_cells.owns: job, buying committee, language register, current alternatives and permissioned recent signal retrieval
team_cells.quality_gate: every audience assertion has a source, recency, scope and uncertainty state
team_cells.failure_signature: demographic persona fiction or universal pain language
team_cells.scorecard: source coverage; segment separation; stale-context rate

team_cells.owns: claim-source graph, witness classes, limitations, rights and exact deletion
team_cells.quality_gate: every released clause resolves to an authorized witness or an explicit hypothesis state
team_cells.failure_signature: citation presence substitutes for claim-level support
team_cells.scorecard: unsupported-clause count; located limitation rate; deletion integrity

team_cells.owns: human tension, category enemy, mother idea, participation mechanism and creative falsifier
team_cells.quality_gate: the idea is recognizable without the logo, feature list or inflated outcome
team_cells.failure_signature: campaign becomes an educational framework with no dramatic act
team_cells.scorecard: three-second comprehension; idea recall; derivative range

team_cells.owns: argument, hook, rhythm, specificity, voice variation and final line-level edit
team_cells.quality_gate: every sentence changes tension, proof or action; no generic AI-marketing filler survives
team_cells.failure_signature: safe explanation outlives the memorable conflict
team_cells.scorecard: deletable-word ratio; hook comprehension; major-rework rate

team_cells.owns: first-frame contract, visible action, beat timing, sound-off comprehension and derivative cut logic
team_cells.quality_gate: conflict, deletion and bounded replacement remain understandable in one silent watch
team_cells.failure_signature: narration explains what the frame failed to show
team_cells.scorecard: first-frame clarity; beat recall; silent-task completion

team_cells.owns: LinkedIn, Reddit, short-video, Instagram and owned-surface psychological jobs
team_cells.quality_gate: each surface has a distinct audience job and no universal caption
team_cells.failure_signature: format changes while the persuasion move remains identical
team_cells.scorecard: duplicate-pair count; native-job clarity; platform blocking defects

team_cells.owns: affiliation, strongest-objection replies, counterexample triage, privacy and public corrections
team_cells.quality_gate: strong disagreement is answered before product links and praise never becomes evidence
team_cells.failure_signature: criticism becomes a sales opportunity or community learning is silently harvested
team_cells.scorecard: located-objection rate; correction latency; unauthorized-learning count

team_cells.owns: crawlable answer objects, direct answers, structured limitations and entity consistency
team_cells.quality_gate: the owned page answers the hard question directly and exposes what remains unproven
team_cells.scorecard: direct-answer completeness; entity consistency; crawl defects

team_cells.owns: seven-job sequence, consent, suppression, review expiry, manual release and rollback
team_cells.quality_gate: every message exists because of an explicit state transition and ends with a stop rule
team_cells.failure_signature: calendar activity substitutes for audience progression
team_cells.scorecard: unauthorized-action count; expired-approval blocks; duplicate-job count

team_cells.owns: decision question, event quality, source-hidden craft review, counterexample reproduction and bounded memory writes
team_cells.quality_gate: observed, missing, synthetic, preference and causal evidence remain machine-separable
team_cells.failure_signature: engagement becomes lift or model judgment becomes human preference

team_cells.owns: content-bound approval, external action, spend, contribution evidence, rollback and audit
team_cells.quality_gate: named human decision binds the exact artifact; pipeline never becomes revenue
team_cells.failure_signature: approval attaches to a campaign name instead of exact bytes
team_cells.scorecard: hash-bound approval coverage; rollback integrity; revenue reconciliation defects

graph_nodes.loop: challenge stage, budget, product truth, audience and goal until one costly strategic choice is explicit
graph_nodes.acceptance: rights-bound brief, named audience job, rejected default and unknown outcomes

graph_nodes.loop: decompose every public sentence and resolve, downgrade, label or delete every clause
graph_nodes.acceptance: approved facts, hypotheses, missing witnesses and limitations are machine-separable

graph_nodes.loop: generate competing campaign acts, reverse likely failures and retain the most ownable falsifiable mechanism
graph_nodes.acceptance: one mother idea, visible act, participation loop, edge play and falsifier

graph_nodes.loop: write four complete assets, remove explanatory filler and preserve the exact approved fact
graph_nodes.acceptance: four publish-shaped assets with distinct arguments and zero unsupported outcomes

graph_nodes.loop: change the audience job, proof order, interaction and rhythm for each selected surface
graph_nodes.acceptance: no semantic copy-paste and each surface has an executable native job

graph_nodes.loop: sequence seven jobs around learning dependencies, consent, fatigue and recoverable failure
graph_nodes.acceptance: seven source-bound jobs, configured caps, review windows, stop rules and recovery

graph_nodes.loop: inspect exact hashes, claims, rights, destination, consent, suppression and rollback
graph_nodes.acceptance: named content-bound human approval or explicit rejection

graph_nodes.loop: validate events, source-hidden reviews, response classes and counterexample reproduction
graph_nodes.acceptance: observation quality and evidence class are explicit; missing remains null

graph_nodes.loop: choose stop, repair or continue from admissible evidence and document the rejected alternative
graph_nodes.acceptance: one reversible action, owner, expiry and falsifier

graph_nodes.loop: write only approved, scoped, expiring and exactly deletable learning with contradiction policy
graph_nodes.acceptance: no autonomous mutation; provenance, scope, expiry and deletion key are complete

blocked: model judge counted as human preference

okr.objective: Make one zero-budget product act more memorable and decision-useful than a conventional feature launch while preserving exact evidence and authority boundaries.
key_results: 4/4 V2 assets enter five-human source-hidden review with zero fabricated votes
7/7 launch jobs have distinct audience purpose, source binding, decision rule and failure recovery
5/5 response surfaces distinguish rule-changing evidence from vanity and unsafe input
12/12 capability cells expose owner, skills, failure signature, quality gate and scorecard
10/10 lifecycle nodes preserve replayable input, output, approval, observation and learning bindings
0 external actions, memory writes or strategy mutations occur without exact authority
0 market, conversion, revenue, 4A or named-product victory claims appear before qualifying evidence

opponent_stress_tests.Adobe Journey Optimizer: Match journey coherence while making one creative act and its clause-level evidence legible across every state.
opponent_stress_tests.Braze: Match event-triggered responsiveness without converting sparse behavior into invasive personalization or automatic mutation.
opponent_stress_tests.HubSpot: Match small-team usability while exposing provenance, rejected claims, community corrections and causal uncertainty.
opponent_stress_tests.Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Match enterprise governance without forcing a zero-budget pre-PMF motion into heavyweight channel breadth.
opponent_stress_tests.Iterable: Match cross-channel experimentation while binding every variant to one falsifiable campaign mechanism and exact release artifact.
opponent_stress_tests.Customer.io: Match flexible messaging while making consent, suppression, identity, response class and stop rules first-class states.
opponent_stress_tests.Klaviyo: Match revenue-oriented segmentation without applying commerce assumptions or treating attributed pipeline as reconciled revenue.
opponent_stress_tests.Hightouch: Match warehouse activation while preventing freshness, identity resolution or audience sync from bypassing authority.
opponent_stress_tests.Clay: Match research-to-outreach speed while keeping source rights, enrichment, message claims and response learning inspectable.
opponent_stress_tests.Apollo: Match prospecting execution while requiring consent-aware targeting, content-bound approval and real incrementality before scale.

open_source_modifications.use: Typed node and artifact contracts around the existing product runtime.
Durable launch state, review expiry, retry, suppression, handoff and rollback.
Held-out optimization of strategy, copy and transcreation modules; scores cannot self-promote.
Identity-minimized event and response-class observation with explicit null outcomes.
Preregistered decisions and guardrails; never a causal shortcut.
Inactive until sufficient real spend and outcome data exist for post-observation analysis.
End-to-end brief, claim, asset, approval, observation, correction and learning lineage.

truth_boundary: This V2 lifecycle candidate binds real local challenger artifacts and explicit zero-action contracts. It contains no publication, audience observation, human preference, named-product comparison, conversion, revenue, 4A or Top-1 proof.
